versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-actiontrail-diagnosis: read-only querying and diagnosis of Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail events.

- Query operation audit logs to find who performed which operation, when, from which IP, on which resource, across any region.
- Always strictly read-only (never writes or modifies any cloud resource).
- Guides users to provide required info (region, time, product/event) and never runs wide, unfiltered queries without confirmation.
- Supports output as a detailed 12-column Markdown table or machine-readable JSON.
- Enforces strict credential safety rules—never outputs secrets.
- Handles multi-region, paginated queries with built-in error handling and summary rendering.
